ns2:section.sectionText: Corresponds with Coursera "Cost Behaviour, Systems and Analysis" and "Tools for Facilitating and Guiding Business Decisions." Registration in this section is restricted to students who have earned a Bachelors Degree. Registration closes 8-3-16. Additional ID verification fee for each 4 week course at Coursera, see: https://business.illinois.edu/online/tuitionfeesandrefund/. This section is open to off-campus students only.
